video_title: Boogie - Kings Have Found Their FRANCHISE Player with Darius Acuff Jr.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. is a franchise player for the Kings
quotes.excerpt: he's a star in the making. I mean, he's here. It's just about him learning how to lead
quotes.quote: Darius Acuff Jr. is a franchise player. He's a star in the making. I mean, he's here. It's just about him learning how to lead a professional group, gain experience in this game, and just keep growing as a player in the league. I think he's got to go through the steps that everybody else has had to go through. He's showing that he has a promising future. He's leading by example, he's a hard worker, he's a good kid, everything you're looking for in a franchise guy. I believe they do have that franchise guy. I just hope they do right around him.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr.'s efficiency will improve with a better roster
quotes.excerpt: his efficiency will continue to get better when they surround him with a better roster
quotes.quote: There's no doubt the kid's a bucket. I think his efficiency will continue to get better when they surround him with a better roster and more talent. He doesn't have to take half these low-percent, highly contested shots. This is in his blood. He's been doing this since high school, he did it in college. He is just an absolute walking bucket. No matter who they add around him, he's still going to have that firepower to go and score 20, 30 points on any given night.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. should carve out his own historical path
quotes.excerpt: Let's allow Darius Acuff Jr. to become the best version of himself
quotes.quote: I like the comparison, but listen, we've made it cool, we've heard it since the draft, now let's get over it. Let's allow Darius Acuff Jr. to become the best version of himself and carve out a lane for himself and do historical things in his own right. Because as soon as something doesn't go right, we're going to go back to the Allen Iverson comparison. As soon as something does go right, we're going to go back to the Allen Iverson comparison. Just allow these young guys to create waves for themselves and to be their own guys.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr.'s ceiling depends on team success
quotes.excerpt: it all depends on their team success
quotes.quote: It all depends on their team success. Ceiling-wise, it's what he's averaging now and be a perennial scorer in this league. It's just we're going to always want to see him do it when it matters the most, in the postseason and on a competing basketball team. This team feels like they're ways away from being even solid and sniffing the play-in, let alone being on a contender. Being on a lesser team like this has given him a lot more opportunity and keys and freedom than he would have if he got drafted to a powerhouse team.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff Jr. has the potential to be an All-Star
quotes.excerpt: I think he has the potential to be a perennial All-Star, All-NBA type player
quotes.quote: I think he has the potential to be a perennial All-Star, All-NBA type player. But that also depends on the supporting cast and the organization that he plays for. Will they put him in the position to reach that potential? The potential is there. We just got to figure out if the foundation will be there.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Wins and losses should not matter for Rookie of the Year
quotes.excerpt: Wins and losses don't matter, it's just about going out there getting numbers

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: Wins and losses shouldn't matter in this award, but it has to, man. If Yaxel is averaging 22, 7, and 4 on a very relevant team with eight wins, I got to give him the nod.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: But wins and losses don't matter, it's just about going out there getting numbers. He's doing that on a nightly basis. So he's definitely putting himself in the position, along with some other young guys in this league. The competition is tough. This is a great rookie class.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony deserved Rookie of the Year over LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: if it's about wins and losses, Carmelo should have got Rookie of the Year

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: We all remember the Carmelo Anthony, LeBron James Rookie of the Year race. So if it's about wins and losses, Carmelo should have got Rookie of the Year.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: If the Kings don't win 20 games, they can't win Rookie of the Year.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: LeBron James, if he was sniffing at Rookie of the Year, he was getting it. That was a different situation. If it's all I'm saying is, if it's about wins and losses, Carmelo as a rookie took his team to the playoffs. On top of going to the playoffs, he had incredible numbers as a rookie. So if it's about that, Carmelo should have got Rookie of the Year.
